variable_used: crop physical area summed across 173 crops
public_release_note: FAO Agro-informatics Platform release announced 2025-05-07; operational integration into FAO geodata platforms highlighted 2025-07-27
interpretation: Used only to estimate crop physical area spatially overlapping a mapped drought footprint; this is not crop damage or yield loss.
caveat: Although CROPGRIDS constrains total crop area by available land, temporary crop physical area can still overestimate distinct cropland where different crops occupy the same land during a year.
